description: 1974 is the Year of the Wood Tiger in the Chinese zodiac, from January 23, 1974 to February 10, 1975. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1974 is the Year of the Wood Tiger, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 23, 1974 and ended on February 10, 1975, so people born in 1974 before Jan 23 belong to the Water Ox year.

sections.heading: When the 1974 Wood Tiger year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1974 Wood Tiger year began at Lunar New Year on January 23, 1974 and lasted until February 10, 1975, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 23 1974 therefore belongs to the Water Ox year that started in 1973, while someone born in early 1975, up to Feb 10, is still a Wood Tiger. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Wood Tiger combination also falls in 2034, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1974 fell on a Wednesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Wood Tiger personality
paragraphs: Friendly, imaginative and generous, the Wood Tiger uses its courage in the service of fairness. The Tiger's fixed element is Wood, so this year doubles it, and tradition describes vision and enthusiasm in abundance. People born now often gather allies around a cause. Scattered energy is the usual caution; choosing a few causes worth fighting for helps. Their warmth often softens their boldness.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: 1974 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year reduce to 3, associated with expression, creativity and sociability, so a 3 year is described as lively and communicative. The digits of 1974 add up to 21, which reduces to 3. In the twelve-year cycle the Tiger is the third animal, earthly branch Yin, with Wood as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Wood, and in the five-element cycles wood year element matches the fixed element. The year before was the Water Ox and the year after is the Wood Rabbit.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Jia-Yin: Jia is the Wood heavenly stem and Yin is the Tiger's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1974?
faq.answer: 1974 is the Year of the Wood Tiger. It started on January 23, 1974 and ended on February 10, 1975.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1974?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 23. Born before January 23, 1974, you are a Water Ox; born on or after it, you are a Wood Tiger.

faq.question: What element is 1974 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yang year. The Tiger's own fixed element is Wood; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1974?
faq.answer: Jia-Yin. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Tiger year?
faq.answer: 2034, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2034.
